Coca-Cola's net income fell about 36.5% from fiscal Q1 2023 to fiscal Q4 2023, using net income attributable to shareowners of The Coca-Cola Company.

- **Q1 2023:** net income was $3,107 million (from the Q1 2024 10-Q's prior-year column).
- **Q4 2023:** the filings give no standalone figure, so I derived it as full-year 2023 less the first nine months. That is $10,714 million − $8,741 million = $1,973 million.
- **Change:** ($1,973 − $3,107) / $3,107 = −36.5%.

Using consolidated net income instead gives −36.2% ($1,986 million in Q4 versus $3,113 million in Q1).
